exposure: Surgical treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
outcome: Recurrent cesarean section scar pregnancy (RCSP) rate
cohort: The study included 105 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who had undergone surgical treatment.
finding: The number of previous cesarean sections was an independent risk factor for recurrent cesarean section scar pregnancy (RCSP), while intraoperative removal of the uterine scar was an independent protective factor.
mod_finding: A higher number of previous cesarean sections was identified as an independent risk factor for recurrent cesarean section scar pregnancy (RCSP).
